Title: Malkavian madness-based cards and Antitrubu Malks

Messages.Author: Hardrock Llewynyth
Messages.Body:

Because of the nature of these cards, i would think that they would be

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
hard...@speakeasy.org (Hardrock Llewynyth) writes:
>What is the ruling on using cards like Malkavian Dementia, Madness
>Network, and Malkavian Derangement: Alternative Personality?

>Because of the nature of these cards, i would think that they would be
>applicable to all malks, not just cam malks. Others have argued
>differently.

Malkavian Antitribu are not member of the Malkavian Clan.
The above-named cards only affect members of the Malkavian Clan,
and therefore cannot be used on a MalkAnti.

Messages.Author: David Schwartz
Messages.Body:
Hardrock Llewynyth writes:
>What is the ruling on using cards like Malkavian Dementia, Madness
>Network, and Malkavian Derangement: Alternative Personality?

>Because of the nature of these cards, i would think that they would be
>applicable to all malks, not just cam malks. Others have argued
>differently.

Nope, don't work. Since Malkavian Antitribu are a seperate
clan. WotC did however add a Derangemt specifically for
Antitribu. (They also made a variant of Ativism for Gangrel
Antitribu.)

Also, Malkavian Antitribu don't work on Malkavian time. That
peculiar device is the binding tie of Cammarila Kooks. That
may explain why their are technically no Malkavian Antribu
clan. That is, there are insane vampires who are members of
the Sabbat, but aren't Pander, but they don't actually consider
themselves a clan, per se. Many of them also believe themselves
to be Napolean, and everyone knows he's a Ventrue. Youy really
have to be insane to understand the logic. They would say you
need the Gift of Caine. They also say you don't exist. Fnord.
